cover.desc: Full color, warm, orderly, and quietly awful. Kotobuki-yu at night seen from slightly above and behind the bandai counter. Nagi is seated at the counter under the warm lamp with the ledger open, calm and completely competent, sliding a small clipped bundle of papers into a pale blue document box — her posture upright, her face unbothered, everything on the countertop squared and in its place. The whole foreground reads as a person who has their affairs in order. Behind her, through the open doorway to the bath hall, out of focus and much smaller: Itsuki mid-scrub on the wet tile in a cloud of steam, entirely unaware, the only loose and unruly shape in the picture. Warm lamp-yellow foreground against cool blue-green steam behind. Nothing in the image looks wrong. That is the image.

chars.expression: incandescent with triumph

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: dawning horror

chars.name: itsuki

chars.name: itsuki

panels.action: His best friend is delighted by a photograph of a lie. He laughs along, because it is funny, and it is.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: still showing the phone to a fourth person
chars.pose: two rows over

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: laughing at something else now
chars.pose: tipped back in his chair

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: half-lidded, working, entirely outside all of it
chars.pose: seated at the window desk

panels.action: An ordinary Friday morning in a classroom.

chars.name: aya
chars.expression: cheerful, filling hers in with enormous confidence
chars.pose: pen flying

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: chewing his pen, stuck on the second line

panels.bg: classroom desks, morning light

dialogue.text: What do I put. What is a five-year plan.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: half-lidded, and underneath it a tiredness she has not had before
chars.pose: writing steadily, sleeve pushed back, knuckles visible

panels.bg: window desk, hard morning light on the paper
panels.action: She has been carrying something for eleven days and it does not show anywhere except in the amount she blinks.

chars.name: aya
chars.expression: genuinely concerned, no teasing in it at all
chars.pose: crouched beside Nagi's desk, chin on her arms

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: unchanged
chars.pose: writing

panels.bg: classroom, window seat, afternoon light
panels.action: Aya has stopped doing the bit. That is new, and Nagi has not noticed.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: completely level, pen not stopping
chars.pose: not looking up

panels.bg: desk, paper, flat screentone
panels.action: A perfect answer. True, unfalsifiable, and it closes the door.

chars.name: aya
chars.expression: sitting back on her heels, not satisfied and not pushing
chars.pose: arms round her knees

panels.bg: classroom floor beside the desk, afternoon light
panels.action: She lets it go. She files it somewhere and lets it go.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: absorbed, sleeves back

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: absorbed, working the corner joint with a smaller brush
chars.pose: crouched at the wall edge

panels.action: Thursday. The routine at full strength — a small brush, a blue brush, two buckets, no conversation required.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: concentrating, entirely at home
chars.pose: crouched at the counter base with a damp cloth, wiping down a pair of worn blue sandals

panels.bg: floorboards, counter base, warm lamp
panels.action: Once a week. It is the fourth time and nobody has mentioned it since the first.

chars.name: fusae
chars.expression: half asleep, blissful
chars.pose: deep in the juddering massage chair

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: grinning
chars.pose: passing with the cloth

panels.bg: rest area, warm lamp, fish clock at 11:12
panels.action: The chair has not been switched off since the day it woke up.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: flat, receiver at her ear, ledger open in front of her
chars.pose: seated at the counter, one hand flat on the page

panels.bg: bandai counter, warm lamp, an old cream-coloured telephone
panels.action: A call at twenty past eleven. She takes it at the counter without getting up.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: nothing whatsoever
chars.pose: receiver at her ear, eyes on the middle distance

panels.bg: counter, warm lamp, flat screentone
panels.action: Whatever is being said at the other end takes about nine seconds to say.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: already writing again
chars.pose: hanging up and picking the pen back up in one movement

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not visible — small, far off through the bath doorway, working
chars.pose: crouched on the tile

panels.bg: counter and the bath doorway beyond, steam, warm lamp
panels.action: Forty feet away, somebody is scrubbing a floor and did not hear any of that.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: tired, absorbed in the accounts, not thinking about it
chars.pose: one hand out sideways with a pinch of receipts in it, eyes on the ledger

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: wiping his hands, coming over
chars.pose: arriving at the counter

panels.bg: bandai counter, warm lamp, ledger, calculator
panels.action: She hands him a job the way she hands him a bucket. He is staff now. She does not think about it for even one second.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: unremarkable, mid-chore
chars.pose: crouched, pulling open the bottom drawer under the counter

panels.bg: under the bandai counter, a deep drawer, warm lamp light falling into it
panels.action: No snooping. He was sent.

panels.bg: the open drawer, lit from above: a pale blue document box, a bundle of rubber bands, a bottle of ink — and lying flat on the lid of the box, two small sets of papers, each squared and held with its own bulldog clip, each with a strip of masking tape on the corner labelled in a neat rounded hand
panels.action: Not hidden. Filed. Two bundles, labelled, clipped, put where paperwork goes.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: hand hovering, glancing once toward the counter above him
chars.pose: crouched, receipts still in his other hand

panels.bg: under the counter, drawer open, warm light from above
panels.action: He has to move them to get the lid off the box. That is genuinely why he picks them up.

panels.bg: the first bundle, top sheet uppermost. ART NOTE: render the DOCUMENT LAYOUT ONLY — no legible characters anywhere. Draw a formal ward-office letter: pale stock, a ruled header block, a small square inkan stamp in red-grey, a date box top right, generous white space. Leave the text lines as blank ruled space for the compositor to typeset over.
panels.action: The letter is beautifully laid out. It is courteous. It has been proofread.

dialogue.text: Notice of consultation — residents and business operators

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: reading, face doing nothing yet
chars.pose: sheet held flat on his knee

panels.bg: under the counter, warm lamp light, drawer open
panels.action: The second paragraph is the one that gets him, and it is the friendliest sentence on the page.

panels.bg: Full page. The reverse of the letter: a small, neatly printed location map of the Sakuragawa shotengai — simple line-drawn blocks, the level crossing, the main road, north arrow, scale bar, the whole thing rendered with the flat competence of municipal print. One irregular block of buildings running the length of the street is filled with a fine diagonal hatch. Kotobuki-yu is inside the hatch, drawn as a plain rectangle exactly like every other plain rectangle. In the bottom corner, a small key box with a hatched swatch beside a blank label line. ART NOTE: no legible characters — layout, hatching and diagram only; the compositor letters the key and the caption.
panels.action: Nobody wrote anything cruel. Somebody just drew a line, correctly, to scale.

panels.bg: the second bundle: a certificate-style form on stiffer stock with a ruled table and an official red-grey stamp, and clipped behind it a plainer estimate sheet from a boiler company with a line-item table and a total box. ART NOTE: layout only, no legible characters — ruled table, stamp, total box, blank lines for the compositor.
panels.action: The second bundle is thinner and much worse.

dialogue.text: Boiler performance inspection — certificate expires 31 March.
Operation is not permitted after this date.

panels.bg: the estimate sheet, close on the line-item table and the boxed total. ART NOTE: layout only — ruled rows, a boxed figure bottom right, blanks for the compositor.
panels.action: One line item, and a number in a box.

dialogue.text: Repair: circulation piping and gauge assembly

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: reading the words gauge assembly and going very still
chars.pose: crouched, sheet flat on his knee

panels.bg: under the counter, warm lamp light — and under the floorboards, the sound
panels.action: The thing on the estimate and the thing she hit four times with her grandfather's wrench are the same object. Nobody in the building says so.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: eyes moving between two sheets, doing arithmetic he does not want the answer to
chars.pose: one sheet in each hand

panels.bg: under the counter, warm lamp, flat screentone
panels.action: A number, a date, and a hatched rectangle. Silent.

panels.bg: the masking-tape label on the corner of the first clip, written in a neat rounded hand — the same hand that took over the logbook. ART NOTE: handwriting shapes only, no legible characters.
panels.action: She labelled them. She wrote a little tape flag so she could find them again quickly.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: calm, tired, entirely on top of it
chars.pose: seated above and behind him at the counter, working the calculator, ledger open, back straight

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not visible — crouched below the counter edge, out of her eyeline
chars.pose: papers on his knee

panels.bg: the bandai counter from below and behind, warm lamp, the two of them a metre apart and on opposite sides of the wood
panels.action: One metre of counter between them. She is not struggling. She has a system. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: n/a — his own hands only
chars.pose: papers held between them; a soft plaster on one finger, a girl's hair tie round the left wrist

panels.bg: flat screentone, warm lamp glow
panels.action: He looks at his own hands for a while.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: arriving somewhere, and it is not a good place
chars.pose: head tipped back against the inside of the counter, eyes shut

panels.bg: the underside of the counter, warm lamp light from above, close
panels.action: Nobody has ever been told anything about him either, and he arranged that himself, and he has never once thought he was owed it. He extends her the same courtesy without noticing what it is. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not looking down, entirely unaware
chars.pose: at the counter above him, turning a page of the ledger

panels.bg: counter top from below, warm lamp, the edge of the ledger
panels.action: She has not asked him for one thing since the night he arrived. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: n/a — hands only, careful
chars.pose: squaring the sheets back under the bulldog clip, tape flag facing the same way it was

panels.bg: the open drawer, warm light from above
panels.action: Corners aligned. Clip the same way round. Tape flag the same way up.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: checking his own work the way he checks a folded noren
chars.pose: laying both bundles flat on the lid of the blue box, exactly where they were

panels.bg: the drawer, blue box, warm light
panels.action: He has become extremely good at putting things back the way he found them. It was supposed to be a kindness.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: standing up, the face already back on
chars.pose: sliding the drawer shut with his knee, receipts filed, cloth over his shoulder

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not looking up from the calculator
chars.pose: at the counter

panels.bg: bandai counter, warm lamp
panels.action: Four seconds to rebuild it. He has had four years of practice.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: working, easy, normal
chars.pose: up a stepladder wiping down the top of the tiled partition

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: unbothered, working
chars.pose: below him, stacking baskets

panels.bg: changing room, warm lamp, ordinary night
panels.action: The rest of the night is completely ordinary. He is very, very good at this.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: grinning down at her, doing a bit about the stepladder
chars.pose: one foot theatrically off the rung

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not looking up
chars.pose: stacking

panels.bg: changing room, stepladder, warm lamp
panels.action: He is funny. It works. It is the first time in seven chapters he has used it on her.

dialogue.text: If I die up here, tell Gonda I was tall.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: grin still on, eyes flat, catchlights gone, looking down at the top of her head
chars.pose: up the ladder, cloth in hand

panels.bg: changing room from above, warm lamp, her small below him
panels.action: Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: level, offhand, closing a drawer
chars.pose: at the counter, back mostly turned

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: coiling a hose, half-listening
chars.pose: crouched

panels.bg: changing room, warm lamp, fish clock at 11:58
panels.action: She gives him an opening she does not know is an opening.

dialogue.text: I'll be late Saturday. I have a thing.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: hands stopping on the hose for exactly one beat
chars.pose: crouched, head down

panels.bg: floorboards, coiled hose, warm lamp
panels.action: He knows what the thing is. He knows the date, the venue and the sentence about voluntary attendance.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — back turned, already moving on
chars.pose: carrying the ledger to the shelf

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: back to coiling the hose
chars.pose: crouched, head down

panels.bg: changing room, warm lamp, the width of the floor between them
panels.action: The boy who invents an aunt in Chiba accepts a one-word lie without a single follow-up question. Neither of them notices what just happened.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: unremarkable, competent
chars.pose: unhooking the noren and folding it correctly without looking at his hands

panels.bg: Kotobuki-yu entrance at 12:04am, sign off, cold clear night
panels.action: Closing. Everything in its correct order, done by two people who both know how.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: half-lidded, writing the night's temperature
chars.pose: at the shelf with the exercise book open on her forearm

panels.bg: boiler-room shelf, bare bulb, the wrench on its nail, the worn mark in the paint beside it
panels.action: Two hands write in that book now. Neither of them has ever said anything about that either.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — reaching up
chars.pose: killing the entrance sign

panels.bg: empty changing room, baskets stacked, fish clock at 12:09, the sandals squared and freshly wiped at the base of the counter, the bottom drawer shut
panels.action: Same as every night.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: loose, tired, comfortable — as unguarded as she gets
chars.pose: sitting on the tile edge with her back to the wall, feet in the water, milk bottle in one hand

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: sitting a metre along the same wall, same posture
chars.pose: bottle balanced on one knee

panels.bg: bath hall, floor finished, heavy steam, one lamp, the chipped Fuji mural above them
panels.action: The good part of the night. It is genuinely the good part.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: looking up at the high window, almost pleasant
chars.pose: head back against the tile

panels.bg: the high frosted window at the far end of the bath hall, steam curling toward it, warm lamp
panels.action: She makes a plan out loud. It is the first time she has ever done that in front of him.

dialogue.text: In summer we prop that window open.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: smiling at her, warm and easy, and the catchlights gone entirely
chars.pose: bottle halfway to his mouth, not drinking

panels.bg: steam, tile, warm lamp — she is out of frame and not looking at him
panels.action: Summer is after the thirty-first of March. She said we. Final panel.
